title: The Trial of Eight Extremes
summary: Mu Sha cannot fully control the Primordial Demon Dragon Hound, because its remnant soul fights his Spirit Driving Art. Lin Dong and Little Flame push him harder, and he dies after burning out his Mental Strength. Little Mink calms the hound with his demon power as a Celestial Demon Marten, and takes its last wisp of soul with them. Behind the stone gate Lin Dong finds the Eight Extremes Sect's manuals and a trial left by an old master's remnant will. The remnant attacks him, and Little Mink tells him to take its palm strike and absorb it into his Yuan Dan. Lin Dong suppresses the energy with his Great Sun Thunder Body. Meanwhile Shi Kun's men find Mu Sha's body and send for Shi Kun.
events: The hound's remnant soul resists Mu Sha's control.
Mu Sha burns out his Mental Strength and dies.
Little Mink tames the Primordial Demon Dragon Hound and takes its remnant soul.
Behind the stone gate is a hall of Eight Extremes manuals and the Eight Extremes True Meaning.
An old master's remnant will tests Lin Dong with attacks that ordinary means cannot touch.
Lin Dong absorbs the master's palm strike into his Yuan Dan and suppresses it with the Great Sun Thunder Body.
Shi Kun's men find Mu Sha's body and report to Shi Kun.

gains: the Demon Dragon Hound's remnant soul (kept by Little Mink)
places: Eight Extremes Sect manual hall and trial ground
